summary.intent: Apply a design-level fix to PR #634 (trail #487): replace scattered origin-remote heuristics with a single parsed Origin value consumed everywhere, and make the 'run callisto version first' hint come from the version planner's own pending-work function, with real-binary tests, changeset, and push.
summary.outcome: Implemented Origin::{Missing,Hosted,NotHosted} and a shared pending_changesets function, migrated all consumers, added e2e/unit tests, updated docs/spec/changeset, passed graph and CLI tests, lint, doc-check and scoped mutants, and created a signed commit. The merge of latest main, push, finding resolution, and lead report were not yet completed in the transcript.

repo: Origin handling previously lived as heuristics in binding.rs, with the dry-run preview fallback in derive.rs applied inconsistently (not in Workspace::forge_repository); now centralized in an Origin enum.
E132 error registry row lives in docs/errors.md and must be updated alongside error.rs changes.
The release spec docs/specs/release.json documents origin behavior and needs updating with behavior changes.
Pending-changeset counting was embedded in aggregate in callisto-graph; splitting the changeset pass out lets the planner and the CLI hint share it (excluding retained prerelease notes).
E2E tests use a Rig/fixture harness in crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_command_e2e_tests.rs.

code.finding: Origin parsing now lives here as Origin::{Missing, Hosted, NotHosted}; the local-path heuristics and file:// match were removed, and E132 refusals mask credentials in the named value.
Pending-work semantics (excluding retained prerelease notes) are the source of truth; exposed as pending_changesets for the hint.
The version hint previously did not show when there was no release plan; it now derives from the planner's pending-work result.

workflow: TLS verification and gpg signing fail inside the sandbox; these commands must run outside it.
Tests touching npm cache fail in the sandbox (~/.npm blocked); run crate tests outside the sandbox.
Miette wraps error messages at terminal width, making string assertions flaky; assert on JSON output instead.
Run scoped cargo mutants only on new decision logic and delete mutants.out* before committing; mutation results revealed gaps (empty-url branch, redaction) that needed extra tests.

friction: Sandbox blocked TLS, gpg signing, and npm cache, forcing reruns outside the sandbox.
Miette line wrapping broke the refusal-message assertion outside the sandbox, requiring a switch to JSON output.
Mutation testing run was long and needed a second pass after adding tests for survivors.
PR #629 is not yet on main, so the file:// match couldn't be removed as a follow-up to it; this branch removes it directly.
open_items: PR #629 is still open and will conflict with this branch in binding.rs when it lands.
